description: Re-issue a short-lived signed download URL for a render artifact the caller owns, so a PDF rendered in an earlier turn can be downloaded without the embedded base64 bytes. Free (no credits). Returns JSON { artifactId, downloadUrl, downloadUrlExpiresAt } and a resource_link to the URL. Owner-scoped; links follow the artifact's normal retention. An unknown, unowned, failed or expired artifact returns the same 'Render not found' error.

artifactId.description: UUID of the render artifact — the `artifactId` returned by a render tool, or the `X-Artifact-Id` response header on a REST render.

name: get_render_download_url

downloadUrl.description: Short-lived signed URL that downloads the PDF with no credential of its own.

downloadUrlExpiresAt.description: When `downloadUrl` stops working, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

title: Get render download URL
